    {A : Set (Cube X)} {J : Cube X} (hJ : J ∈ badTwo A) : liEnergy p A J = 0 := by
  rw [← li_quadratic_form hp hp1]
  have h (x : Cube X) : ind A x * extension (ind A) (liCoord p J x) = 0 := by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ A
    · rw [li_extension_vanish hp hJ hx, mul_zero]
    · simp [ind, hx]
  simp_rw [h, avg_const]

theorem monoWeight_neg_lower {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (I : Cube X) :
    -monoWeight b I ≤ monoWeight (-b) I := by
  have he : |monoWeight (-b) I| = monoWeight b I := by
    rw [monoWeight, Finset.abs_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    cases I i <;> simp [abs_of_nonneg hb]
  simpa only [he] using neg_abs_le (monoWeight (-b) I)

/-- The nonconstant Fourier squares give an explicit covering certificate.
This is the pointwise form of Li's spectral lower bound. -/
theorem li_cover_bound {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    {A : Set (Cube X)} {J : Cube X} (hJ : J ∈ badTwo A) :
    (measure p A)^2 ≤ highEnergy p (1/2) A J := by
  have hpoint (I : Cube X) : (if I = ⊥ then (measure p A)^2 else 0) ≤
      (if I ≤ J then (coeff p (ind A) I)^2 * monoWeight (liLambda p) I else 0) +
      (if I ≤ J then highCoeff p (1/2) A I else 0) := by
    by_cases hi : I = ⊥
    · subst I; simp [coeff_bot, measure, monoWeight_bot, highCoeff]
    · simp only [if_neg hi, highCoeff]
      by_cases hij : I ≤ J
      · simp only [if_pos hij, if_neg hi, liLambda_eq_beta]
        have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (monoWeight_neg_lower (beta_pos hp hp1 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2)
            (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ)<1)).le I)
          (sq_nonneg (coeff p (ind A) I))
        linarith
      · simp [hij]
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := (univ : Finset (Cube X))) (fun I _ => hpoint I)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hs
  have hz := liEnergy_zero hp hp1 hJ
  unfold liEnergy at hz
  simpa only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true,
    hz, zero_add, highEnergy] using hs

theorem highEnergy_average {p a r : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hbr : beta p a*r ≤ 1)
    (ν : Law X) (hν : ν.Spread r) (A : Set (Cube X)) :
    (∑ J, ν.weight J * highEnergy p a A J) ≤
      (beta p a*r)*(measure p A-(measure p A)^2) := by
  have he : (∑ J, ν.weight J * highEnergy p a A J) =
      ∑ I, highCoeff p a A I * (∑ J, if I ≤ J then ν.weight J else 0) := by
    simp only [highEnergy, Finset.mul_sum, mul_ite, mul_zero, ite_mul, zero_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro I _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro J _
    split_ifs <;> ring
  rw [he]
  exact (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun I _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (hν I) (highCoeff_nonneg hp hp1 ha ha1 A I))).trans
      (high_cost hp hp1 ha ha1 hr hbr A)

/-- A probability is carried by A exactly when all positive atoms belong to A. -/
def Law.Carried (ν : Law X) (A : Set (Cube X)) : Prop :=
  ∀ J, 0 < ν.weight J → J ∈ A

/-- Chen Li, Theorem 1.9, with its exact quantitative constant. -/
theorem li_theorem_1_9 {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (A : Set (Cube X)) (ν : Law X) (hν : ν.Spread p) (hcar : ν.Carried (badTwo A)) :
    measure p A ≤ (1-p)/(2-p) := by
  have hpoint (J : Cube X) : ν.weight J*(measure p A)^2 ≤
      ν.weight J*highEnergy p (1/2) A J := by
    by_cases hJ : 0 < ν.weight J
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (li_cover_bound hp hp1 (hcar J hJ)) (ν.nonneg J)
    · have hz : ν.weight J = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hJ) (ν.nonneg J)
      simp [hz]
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := (univ : Finset (Cube X))) (fun J _ => hpoint J)
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ν.total, one_mul] at hs
  have hc := highEnergy_average hp hp1 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2)
    (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ)<1) hp.le
    (show beta p (1/2)*p ≤ 1 by rw [beta_half hp hp1]; linarith) ν hν A
  rw [beta_half hp hp1] at hc
  have hm0 := measure_nonneg hp.le hp1.le A
  have hd : 0 < 2-p := by linarith
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hd]
  by_cases hm : measure p A = 0
  · rw [hm]; linarith
  · have hmpos : 0 < measure p A := lt_of_le_of_ne hm0 (Ne.symm hm)
    have hprod : measure p A*((2-p)*measure p A-(1-p)) ≤ 0 := by nlinarith
    have hf : (2-p)*measure p A-(1-p) ≤ 0 := by
      by_contra hn
      have hc := mul_pos hmpos (lt_of_not_ge hn)
      linarith
    nlinarith

/-- Li's two-union conclusion holds even at density exactly one half. -/
theorem li_no_spread_badTwo {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (A : Set (Cube X)) (hm : (1:ℝ)/2 ≤ measure p A) :
    ¬ ∃ ν : Law X, ν.Spread p ∧ ν.Carried (badTwo A) := by
  rintro ⟨ν, hν, hcar⟩
  have h := li_theorem_1_9 hp hp1 A ν hν hcar
  have hd : 0 < 2-p := by linarith
  have h' := (le_div_iff₀ hd).mp h
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm hd.le]

/-- Explicit certificate extracted from Li's vanishing quadratic form. -/
def liCertificate (p : ℝ) (A : Set (Cube X)) (I : Cube X) : ℝ :=
  highCoeff p (1/2) A I / (measure p A)^2

theorem li_fractional_certificate {p r : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (A : Set (Cube X)) (hm : 0 < measure p A) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hbr : beta p (1/2)*r ≤ 1) :
    (∀ I, 0 ≤ liCertificate p A I) ∧
    (∑ I, liCertificate p A I * monoWeight r I) ≤
      (beta p (1/2)*r)*(measure p A-(measure p A)^2)/(measure p A)^2 ∧
    ∀ J ∈ badTwo A, 1 ≤ ∑ I, if I ≤ J then liCertificate p A I else 0 := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro I
    exact div_nonneg (highCoeff_nonneg hp hp1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) A I) (sq_nonneg _)
  · have h := high_cost hp hp1 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2)
      (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ)<1) hr hbr A
    simpa only [liCertificate, div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← Finset.sum_div] using
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h (sq_nonneg (measure p A))
  · intro J hJ
    have he : (∑ I : Cube X, if I ≤ J then liCertificate p A I else 0) =
        highEnergy p (1/2) A J / (measure p A)^2 := by
      simp only [liCertificate, highEnergy, Finset.sum_div, ite_div, zero_div]
    rw [he, one_le_div (sq_pos_of_pos hm)]
    exact li_cover_bound hp hp1 hJ

theorem li_weaklySmall_of_bound {p r : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (A : Set (Cube X)) (hm : 0 < measure p A) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hbr : beta p (1/2)*r ≤ 1)
    (hcost : (beta p (1/2)*r)*(measure p A-(measure p A)^2) ≤ (measure p A)^2/2) :
    WeaklySmall r (badTwo A) := by
  obtain ⟨hc, hsum, hcover⟩ := li_fractional_certificate hp hp1 A hm hr hbr
  refine ⟨liCertificate p A, hc, hsum.trans ?_, hcover⟩
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hm)]
  linarith

/-- Original cost-1/2 weak p-smallness, with density improved from 3/4 to 2/3
and only two unions. No duality normalization is hidden in this statement. -/
theorem li_weaklySmall_badTwo {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (A : Set (Cube X)) (hm : (2:ℝ)/3 ≤ measure p A) :
    WeaklySmall p (badTwo A) := by
  have hm0 : 0 < measure p A := by linarith
  have hm1 := measure_le_one hp.le hp1.le A
  have hv : 0 ≤ measure p A-(measure p A)^2 := by nlinarith
  apply li_weaklySmall_of_bound hp hp1 A hm0 hp.le
    (show beta p (1/2)*p ≤ 1 by rw [beta_half hp hp1]; linarith)
  rw [beta_half hp hp1]
  have h1 := mul_le_of_le_one_left hv (show 1-p ≤ 1 by linarith)
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ measure p A-2/3 by linarith) hm0.le]

/-- At density one half, the explicit certificate has cost <= 1/2 at p/2. -/
theorem li_weaklySmall_badTwo_half {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (A : Set (Cube X)) (hm : (1:ℝ)/2 ≤ measure p A) :
    WeaklySmall (p/2) (badTwo A) := by
  have hm0 : 0 < measure p A := by linarith
  have hm1 := measure_le_one hp.le hp1.le A
  have hv : 0 ≤ measure p A-(measure p A)^2 := by nlinarith
  have hb : beta p (1/2)*(p/2) = (1-p)/2 := by nlinarith [beta_half hp hp1]
  apply li_weaklySmall_of_bound hp hp1 A hm0 (by positivity)
    (show beta p (1/2)*(p/2) ≤ 1 by rw [hb]; linarith)
  rw [hb]
  have h1 := mul_le_of_le_one_left hv (show 1-p ≤ 1 by linarith)
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ measure p A-1/2 by linarith) hm0.le]

theorem badThree_subset_badTwo (A : Set (Cube X)) : badUnions 3 A ⊆ badTwo A := by
  intro J hJ
  rintro ⟨Y, hY, Z, hZ, hc⟩
  apply hJ
  let f : Fin 3 → Cube X := fun j => if j.val = 0 then Y else Z
  refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j; dsimp [f]; split_ifs <;> assumption
  · intro i
    apply (hc i).trans
    apply sup_le
    · have h := Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : Fin 3 => f j i) (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin 3))
      simpa [f, unionOf] using h
    · have h := Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : Fin 3 => f j i) (Finset.mem_univ (1 : Fin 3))
      simpa [f, unionOf] using h

/-- The original Conjecture 7.2 with q=3, replacing q=4. The stronger
two-union statement is `li_weaklySmall_badTwo`; Li's exact spread-measure
statement is `li_theorem_1_9` and its half-density consequence above. -/
theorem conjecture_7_2 {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (A : Set (Cube X)) (hm : 1-(1:ℝ)/3 ≤ measure p A) :
    WeaklySmall p (badUnions 3 A) := by
  exact (li_weaklySmall_badTwo hp hp1 A (by linarith)).mono (badThree_subset_badTwo A)

end
end TalagrandConjectures

import TalagrandConjectures.Energy

open Finset Classical
namespace TalagrandConjectures
noncomputable section
variable {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]

theorem measure_pos {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    {A : Set (Cube X)} (hA : A.Nonempty) : 0 < measure p A := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hA
  have h : mass p x * ind A x ≤ measure p A :=
    Finset.single_le_sum
      (f := fun y => mass p y * ind A y)
      (fun y _ => mul_nonneg (mass_nonneg hp.le hp1.le y) (ind_nonneg A y))
      (Finset.mem_univ x)
  simpa [ind, hx] using (mass_pos hp hp1 x).trans_le (by simpa [ind, hx] using h)

theorem Law.log_bound (ν : Law X) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (f : Cube X → ℝ) (hf : ∀ J, 0 < f J)
    (havg : (∑ J, ν.weight J * f J) ≤ M) :
    (∑ J, ν.weight J * Real.log (f J)) ≤ Real.log M := by
  have ht (J : Cube X) : Real.log (f J) ≤ Real.log M + (f J/M - 1) := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos (hf J) hM)
    rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hf J)) (ne_of_gt hM)] at h
    linarith
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := (univ : Finset (Cube X)))
    (fun J _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ht J) (ν.nonneg J))
  have he : (∑ J, ν.weight J * (Real.log M + (f J/M - 1))) =
      Real.log M + (∑ J, ν.weight J*f J)/M - 1 := by
    simp only [mul_add, mul_sub, mul_one, mul_div_assoc,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_div,
      ← Finset.sum_mul, ν.total, one_mul]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    ring
  rw [he] at hs
  have hd : (∑ J, ν.weight J*f J)/M ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hM).mpr havg
  linarith

/-- The strong logarithmic inequality of Park--Talagrand, proved from the
finite Walsh expansion and the vanishing/Cauchy--Schwarz argument. -/
theorem logarithmic_inequality {p a r : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hbr : beta p a*r ≤ 1)
    (ν : Law X) (hν : ν.Spread r) {A : Set (Cube X)} (hA : Down A)
    (hne : A.Nonempty) :
    Real.log (measure p A) ≤ ∑ J, ν.weight J * Real.log (theta a A J) := by
  have hm := measure_pos hp hp1 hne
  have hc (J : Cube X) := core_inequality hp hp1 ha ha1 hA J
  have hQ (J : Cube X) : 0 < energy p a A J := by
    have hn := theta_nonneg ha.le ha1.le A J
    by_contra h
    have hh := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hn (le_of_not_gt h)
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hm, hc J]
  have hT (J : Cube X) : 0 < theta a A J := by
    by_contra h
    have hh := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (le_of_not_gt h) (hQ J).le
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hm, hc J]
  have hpoint (J : Cube X) : 2*Real.log (measure p A) ≤
      Real.log (theta a A J) + Real.log (energy p a A J) := by
    have h := Real.log_le_log (sq_pos_of_pos hm) (hc J)
    rw [Real.log_pow, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (hT J)) (ne_of_gt (hQ J))] at h
    norm_num at h ⊢
    exact h
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := (univ : Finset (Cube X)))
    (fun J _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpoint J) (ν.nonneg J))
  simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, ν.total, one_mul] at hs
  have hlog := ν.log_bound hm (energy p a A) hQ
    (energy_average hp hp1 ha ha1 hr hbr ν hν A)
  linarith

theorem beta_half {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) :
    beta p (1/2) * p = 1-p := by
  unfold beta
  field_simp
  <;> ring

/-- Conjecture 9.1 in its consistent down-class/logarithmic form (9.2),
with the explicit universal constant alpha=1/2. -/
theorem conjecture_9_1 {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1/2)
    (ν : Law X) (hν : ν.Spread ((1/2)*p))
    {A : Set (Cube X)} (hA : Down A) (hne : A.Nonempty) :
    Real.log (measure p A) ≤ ∑ J, ν.weight J * Real.log (theta (1/2) A J) := by
  have hp' : p < 1 := by linarith
  apply logarithmic_inequality hp hp' (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (by positivity) ?_ ν hν hA hne
  have h := beta_half hp hp'
  nlinarith

/-- Conjecture 7.9: domination of the thinned law on every up-class,
with alpha=1/2 and the same alpha in the spreadness parameter. -/
theorem conjecture_7_9_half {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ν : Law X) (hν : ν.Spread ((1/2)*p))
    {A : Set (Cube X)} (hA : Up A) :
    (∑ J, ν.weight J * theta (1/2) A J) ≤ measure p A := by
  have hpoint (J : Cube X) : theta (1/2) A J ≤
      1 - 2*measure p Aᶜ + energy p (1/2) Aᶜ J := by
    have h := theta_up_bound hp hp1 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2)
      (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ)<1) hA J
    rw [energy_split, measure_compl]
    nlinarith
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := (univ : Finset (Cube X)))
    (fun J _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpoint J) (ν.nonneg J))
  simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, ν.total, one_mul] at hs
  have he := energy_average hp hp1 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2)
    (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ)<1) (by positivity : 0 ≤ (1/2)*p)
    (show beta p (1/2)*((1/2)*p) ≤ 1 by nlinarith [beta_half hp hp1]) ν hν Aᶜ
  rw [measure_compl] at he hs
  linarith

end
end TalagrandConjectures

import TalagrandConjectures.Certificates

open Finset Classical
namespace TalagrandConjectures
noncomputable section
variable {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]

def flip (x : Cube X) : Cube X := fun i => !(x i)
theorem flip_flip (x : Cube X) : flip (flip x) = x := by
  funext i; simp [flip]
theorem avg_half_flip (f : Cube X → ℝ) :
    avg (1/2) (fun x => f (flip x)) = avg (1/2) f := by
  let e : Cube X ≃ Cube X := ⟨flip, flip, flip_flip, flip_flip⟩
  have hm (x : Cube X) : mass (1/2) (flip x) = mass (1/2) x := by
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    cases h : x i <;> norm_num [bit, flip, h]
  have h := Equiv.sum_comp e (fun x => mass (1/2) x * f x)
  change (∑ x, mass (1/2) (flip x) * f (flip x)) = ∑ x, mass (1/2) x * f x at h
  simpa only [hm, avg] using h

def badTwo (A : Set (Cube X)) : Set (Cube X) :=
  {J | ¬ ∃ Y ∈ A, ∃ Z ∈ A, J ≤ fun i => Y i || Z i}
def unionOf {q : ℕ} (f : Fin q → Cube X) : Cube X :=
  fun i => univ.sup (fun j => f j i)
def badUnions (q : ℕ) (A : Set (Cube X)) : Set (Cube X) :=
  {J | ¬ ∃ f : Fin q → Cube X, (∀ j, f j ∈ A) ∧ J ≤ unionOf f}

theorem badTwo_theta {A : Set (Cube X)} {J : Cube X} (hJ : J ∈ badTwo A) :
    theta (1/2) A J ≤ 1/2 := by
  have hpoint (x : Cube X) : ind A (restrict J x) + ind A (restrict J (flip x)) ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases hx : restrict J x ∈ A
    · have hn : restrict J (flip x) ∉ A := by
        intro hy
        apply hJ
        refine ⟨restrict J x, hx, restrict J (flip x), hy, ?_⟩
        intro i
        cases h1 : J i <;> cases h2 : x i <;> simp [restrict, flip, h1, h2]
      simp [ind, hx, hn]
    · have h1 := ind_le_one A (restrict J (flip x))
      simpa [ind, hx] using h1
  have h := avg_mono (p := (1/2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hpoint
  rw [avg_add, avg_half_flip (fun x => ind A (restrict J x)), avg_const] at h
  change theta (1/2) A J + theta (1/2) A J ≤ 1 at h
  linarith

theorem weaklySmall_badTwo_down {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    {A : Set (Cube X)} (hA : Down A) (hm : (3 : ℝ)/4 ≤ measure p A) :
    WeaklySmall p (badTwo A) := by
  have hm1 := measure_le_one hp.le hp1.le A
  have hv : 0 ≤ measure p A - (measure p A)^2 := by
    have hm0 := measure_nonneg hp.le hp1.le A
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨fun I => (8/3 : ℝ) * highCoeff p (1/2) A I, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro I
    exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (highCoeff_nonneg hp hp1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) A I)
  · have h := high_cost hp hp1 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2)
      (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ)<1) hp.le
      (show beta p (1/2)*p ≤ 1 by rw [beta_half hp hp1]; linarith) A
    rw [beta_half hp hp1] at h
    have hmul : (1-p)*(measure p A - (measure p A)^2) ≤ measure p A - (measure p A)^2 :=
      mul_le_of_le_one_left hv (by linarith)
    simp only [mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (measure p A - 3/4)]
  · intro J hJ
    have hθ := badTwo_theta hJ
    have hbound := theta_up_bound hp hp1 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2)
      (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ)<1) hA.compl J
    rw [theta_compl, measure_compl, compl_compl] at hbound
    have hsq : (1-measure p A)^2 ≤ 1/16 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ measure p A-3/4 by linarith)
        (show 0 ≤ 1-measure p A by linarith)]
    have he : (∑ I : Cube X, if I ≤ J then (8/3:ℝ)*highCoeff p (1/2) A I else 0) =
        (8/3:ℝ)*highEnergy p (1/2) A J := by
      simp [highEnergy, Finset.mul_sum, mul_ite]
    rw [he]
    nlinarith

def downClosure (A : Set (Cube X)) : Set (Cube X) := {x | ∃ y ∈ A, x ≤ y}
theorem downClosure_down (A : Set (Cube X)) : Down (downClosure A) := by
  rintro x ⟨z, hz, hxz⟩ y hy
  exact ⟨z, hz, hy.trans hxz⟩
theorem subset_downClosure (A : Set (Cube X)) : A ⊆ downClosure A :=
  fun x hx => ⟨x, hx, le_rfl⟩
theorem measure_mono {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    {A B : Set (Cube X)} (h : A ⊆ B) : measure p A ≤ measure p B := by
  apply avg_mono hp hp1
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ A
  · simp [ind, hx, h hx]
  · simp [ind, hx]; split_ifs <;> norm_num

theorem badTwo_subset_downClosure (A : Set (Cube X)) :
    badTwo A ⊆ badTwo (downClosure A) := by
  intro J hJ
  rintro ⟨Y, ⟨Y', hY', hY⟩, Z, ⟨Z', hZ', hZ⟩, hc⟩
  apply hJ
  refine ⟨Y', hY', Z', hZ', ?_⟩
  intro i
  exact (hc i).trans (sup_le_sup (hY i) (hZ i))

theorem weaklySmall_badTwo {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    {A : Set (Cube X)} (hm : (3 : ℝ)/4 ≤ measure p A) :
    WeaklySmall p (badTwo A) := by
  have hm' := hm.trans (measure_mono hp.le hp1.le (subset_downClosure A))
  exact (weaklySmall_badTwo_down hp hp1 (downClosure_down A) hm').mono
    (badTwo_subset_downClosure A)

theorem badFour_subset_badTwo (A : Set (Cube X)) : badUnions 4 A ⊆ badTwo A := by
  intro J hJ
  rintro ⟨Y, hY, Z, hZ, hc⟩
  apply hJ
  let f : Fin 4 → Cube X := fun j => if j.val = 0 then Y else Z
  refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j; dsimp [f]; split_ifs <;> assumption
  · intro i
    apply (hc i).trans
    apply sup_le
    · have h := Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : Fin 4 => f j i) (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin 4))
      simpa [f, unionOf] using h
    · have h := Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : Fin 4 => f j i) (Finset.mem_univ (1 : Fin 4))
      simpa [f, unionOf] using h

/-- Conjecture 7.2 with q=4, for arbitrary families, in the original
fractional-cover definition of weak p-smallness. -/
theorem conjecture_7_2_q4 {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (A : Set (Cube X)) (hm : 1-(1:ℝ)/4 ≤ measure p A) :
    WeaklySmall p (badUnions 4 A) := by
  exact (weaklySmall_badTwo hp hp1 (by linarith : (3:ℝ)/4 ≤ measure p A)).mono
    (badFour_subset_badTwo A)

end
end TalagrandConjectures

import TalagrandIntegral.Imports

set_option autoImplicit false

open Finset Classical
namespace TalagrandIntegral
noncomputable section
variable {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]

def coverCost (p : ℝ) (G : Finset (Finset X)) : ℝ := ∑ S ∈ G, p^S.card
def Covers (G F : Finset (Finset X)) : Prop := ∀ H ∈ F, ∃ S ∈ G, S ⊆ H
def Small (p : ℝ) (F : Finset (Finset X)) : Prop :=
  ∃ G, Covers G F ∧ coverCost p G ≤ 1/2
def FractionalCover (r : ℝ) (F : Finset (Finset X)) (g : Finset X → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ S, 0 ≤ g S ∧ g S ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ H ∈ F, 1 ≤ ∑ S ∈ H.powerset, g S) ∧ (∑ S, g S*r^S.card) ≤ 1/2

theorem Small.mono_family {p : ℝ} {A B : Finset (Finset X)} (h : Small p A) (hBA : B ⊆ A) :
    Small p B := by
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hc⟩ := h
  exact ⟨G, fun H hH => hG H (hBA hH), hc⟩

theorem Small.mono_density {p r : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hpr : p ≤ r)
    {F : Finset (Finset X)} (h : Small r F) : Small p F := by
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hc⟩ := h
  refine ⟨G, hG, le_trans ?_ hc⟩
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro S _
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hp hpr _

theorem small_empty (p : ℝ) : Small p (∅ : Finset (Finset X)) := by
  exact ⟨∅, by simp [Covers], by norm_num [coverCost]⟩

def productMass {C : Type} [Fintype C] (π : C → ℝ) (a : X → C) : ℝ := ∏ x, π (a x)

theorem productMass_nonneg {C : Type} [Fintype C] {π : C → ℝ}
    (hπ : ∀ c, 0 ≤ π c) (a : X → C) : 0 ≤ productMass π a :=
  Finset.prod_nonneg (fun x _ => hπ (a x))

theorem productMass_sum {C : Type} [Fintype C] (π : C → ℝ) (hπ : ∑ c, π c = 1) :
    (∑ a : X → C, productMass π a) = 1 := by
  unfold productMass
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun (_ : X) c => π c)]
  simp [hπ]

theorem productMass_factor {C : Type} [Fintype C] (π : C → ℝ) (f : X → C → ℝ) :
    (∑ a : X → C, productMass π a * ∏ x, f x (a x)) =
      ∏ x, ∑ c, π c*f x c := by
  simp only [productMass, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  exact (Fintype.prod_sum (fun x c => π c*f x c)).symm

end
end TalagrandIntegral

import TalagrandIntegral.Truncation
import TalagrandIntegral.Basic

set_option autoImplicit false

open Finset Classical
namespace TalagrandIntegral
noncomputable section
variable {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] {s : ℕ}

abbrev Coloring (X : Type) (s : ℕ) := X → Fin (s+1)
def initial (z : Coloring X s) (i : Fin s) : Finset X :=
  univ.filter (fun x => (z x).val ≤ i.val)
def changed (a z : Coloring X s) : Finset X := univ.filter (fun x => z x < a x)
def crossings (a z : Coloring X s) (i : Fin s) : Finset X :=
  univ.filter (fun x => (z x).val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < (a x).val)
def moveLength (a z : Coloring X s) : ℕ := ∑ x, ((a x).val - (z x).val)
def deficit (i : Fin s) : ℝ := 1/(2:ℝ)^(i.val+1)

def Feasible (F : Finset (Finset X)) (w : Finset X → X → ℝ)
    (a z : Coloring X s) : Prop :=
  ∃ H ∈ F, ∀ i : Fin s, ∃ ε,
    Admissible (w H) (initial z i) (deficit i) (crossings a z i).card ε

def MinimalMove (F : Finset (Finset X)) (w : Finset X → X → ℝ)
    (a z : Coloring X s) : Prop :=
  z ≤ a ∧ Feasible F w a z ∧ ∃ H₀ ∈ F, changed a z ⊆ H₀ ∧
    ∀ z', z' ≤ a → Feasible F w a z' → changed a z' ⊆ H₀ →
      moveLength a z ≤ moveLength a z'

theorem deficit_pos (i : Fin s) : 0 < deficit i := by unfold deficit; positivity
theorem deficit_lt_one (i : Fin s) : deficit i < 1 := by
  unfold deficit
  rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]
  exact one_lt_pow₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)

def delay (z : Coloring X s) (x : X) (hx : (z x).val < s) : Coloring X s :=
  Function.update z x ⟨(z x).val+1, by omega⟩

theorem delay_le {a z : Coloring X s} (hza : z ≤ a) {x : X} (hx : z x < a x)
    (hxs : (z x).val < s) : delay z x hxs ≤ a := by
  intro y
  by_cases hy : y = x
  · subst y; simp only [delay, Function.update_self]
    change (z x).val+1 ≤ (a x).val
    have h : (z x).val < (a x).val := hx
    omega
  · simpa [delay, hy] using hza y

theorem changed_delay_subset {a z : Coloring X s} {x : X} (hxs : (z x).val < s) :
    changed a (delay z x hxs) ⊆ changed a z := by
  intro y hy
  simp only [changed, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hy ⊢
  by_cases h : y = x
  · subst y; simp only [delay, Function.update_self] at hy
    exact lt_trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self _) hy
  · simpa [delay, h] using hy

theorem initial_delay (z : Coloring X s) (x : X) (hxs : (z x).val < s) (i : Fin s) :
    initial (delay z x hxs) i = if i.val = (z x).val then (initial z i).erase x else initial z i := by
  ext y
  by_cases hy : y = x
  · subst y
    simp only [initial, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, delay, Function.update_self]
    split_ifs with h <;> simp_all [Finset.mem_erase] <;> omega
  · split_ifs <;> simp [initial, delay, hy, Finset.mem_erase]

theorem crossings_delay {a z : Coloring X s} (x : X) (hxs : (z x).val < s) (i : Fin s) :
    crossings a (delay z x hxs) i =
      if i.val = (z x).val then (crossings a z i).erase x else crossings a z i := by
  ext y
  by_cases hy : y = x
  · subst y
    simp only [crossings, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, delay, Function.update_self]
    split_ifs with h <;> simp_all [Finset.mem_erase] <;> omega
  · split_ifs <;> simp [crossings, delay, hy, Finset.mem_erase]

theorem moveLength_delay {a z : Coloring X s} (hza : z ≤ a) (x : X)
    (hx : z x < a x) (hxs : (z x).val < s) :
    moveLength a (delay z x hxs) + 1 = moveLength a z := by
  unfold moveLength
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (mem_univ x),
      ← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (mem_univ x)]
  have he : (∑ y ∈ univ.erase x, ((a y).val-(delay z x hxs y).val)) =
      ∑ y ∈ univ.erase x, ((a y).val-(z y).val) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro y hy
    simp [delay, (mem_erase.mp hy).1]
  rw [he]
  simp only [delay, Function.update_self]
  have hx' : (z x).val < (a x).val := hx
  omega

/-- Deleting a low-weight moved vertex preserves the charged truncation test. -/
theorem admissible_erase (w : X → ℝ) (A : Finset X) {d ε : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    (h : Admissible w A d m ε) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ A) (hwx : w x ≤ ε) (hm : 0 < m) :
    Admissible w (A.erase x) d (m-1) ε := by
  refine ⟨h.1, h.2.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    by_cases he : y = x
    · simpa [he] using hwx
    · exact h.2.2.1 y (by simpa [mem_erase, he] using hy)
  · have he : truncSum w (A.erase x) d ε = truncSum w A d ε - min (w x) ε := by
      have hp (y : X) : min (w y) ε * ((if y ∈ A.erase x then 1 else 0)-(1-d)) =
          min (w y) ε * ((if y ∈ A then 1 else 0)-(1-d)) -
            (if y = x then min (w x) ε else 0) := by
        by_cases hy : y = x
        · subst y; simp [hx]; ring
        · simp [mem_erase, hy]
      simp_rw [truncSum, hp, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      simp
    rw [he]
    have hm' : ((m-1:ℕ):ℝ) = (m:ℝ)-1 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]; norm_num
    have hmin : min (w x) ε ≤ ε := min_le_right _ _
    nlinarith [h.2.2.2]

/-- The reconstruction inclusion (2.9), for any common feasible witness.
Minimality concerns total color displacement, not just the number of vertices. -/
theorem minimal_move_reconstruction {F : Finset (Finset X)} {w : Finset X → X → ℝ}
    {a z : Coloring X s} (hz : MinimalMove F w a z)
    {H : Finset X} (hH : H ∈ F) (ε : Fin s → ℝ)
    (hε : ∀ i, Admissible (w H) (initial z i) (deficit i) (crossings a z i).card (ε i))
    (x : X) (hx : z x < a x) :
    ε ⟨(z x).val, by have h := (a x).isLt; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx (Nat.le_of_lt_succ h)⟩ < w H x := by
  have hxs : (z x).val < s := by have h := (a x).isLt; omega
  let i : Fin s := ⟨(z x).val, hxs⟩
  change ε i < w H x
  by_contra hn
  have hwx : w H x ≤ ε i := le_of_not_gt hn
  let z' := delay z x hxs
  have hfeas : Feasible F w a z' := by
    refine ⟨H, hH, ?_⟩
    intro j
    refine ⟨ε j, ?_⟩
    dsimp [z']
    rw [initial_delay, crossings_delay]
    by_cases hj : j.val = (z x).val
    · have hji : j = i := Fin.ext hj
      subst j
      simp only [i, if_true]
      have hmem : x ∈ crossings a z i := by simp [crossings, i, hx]
      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hmem]
      simpa only [Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ (crossings a z i).card from Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨x, hmem⟩), Nat.cast_one] using admissible_erase (w H) (initial z i) (hε i)
        (by simp [initial, i]) hwx (Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨x, hmem⟩)
    · simp only [if_neg hj]; exact hε j
  obtain ⟨H₀, hH₀, hsub, hmin⟩ := hz.2.2
  have hm := hmin z' (delay_le hz.1 hx hxs) hfeas ((changed_delay_subset hxs).trans hsub)
  have he := moveLength_delay hz.1 x hx hxs
  change moveLength a z' + 1 = moveLength a z at he
  omega

theorem exists_minimal_move {F : Finset (Finset X)} {w : Finset X → X → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ H ∈ F, ∀ x, 0 ≤ w H x)
    (hsupp : ∀ H ∈ F, ∀ x ∉ H, w H x = 0)
    (a : Coloring X s) {H₀ : Finset X} (hH₀ : H₀ ∈ F) :
    ∃ z, MinimalMove F w a z ∧ changed a z ⊆ H₀ := by
  let z₀ : Coloring X s := fun x => if x ∈ H₀ then 0 else a x
  have hle : z₀ ≤ a := by intro x; dsimp [z₀]; split_ifs <;> simp
  have hsub : changed a z₀ ⊆ H₀ := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hn
    simpa [changed, z₀, hn] using hx
  have hf : Feasible F w a z₀ := by
    refine ⟨H₀, hH₀, ?_⟩
    intro i
    refine ⟨0, admissible_zero (w H₀) (hw H₀ hH₀) _ _ _ ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    apply hsupp H₀ hH₀ x
    intro hxH
    exact hx (by simp [initial, z₀, hxH])
  let Z := univ.filter (fun z => z ≤ a ∧ Feasible F w a z ∧ changed a z ⊆ H₀)
  have hZ : Z.Nonempty := ⟨z₀, by simp [Z, hle, hf, hsub]⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hmin⟩ := Z.exists_min_image (moveLength a) hZ
  have hz' := (mem_filter.mp hz).2
  refine ⟨z, ⟨hz'.1, hz'.2.1, H₀, hH₀, hz'.2.2, ?_⟩, hz'.2.2⟩
  intro z' hz' hf' hs'
  exact hmin z' (by simp [Z, hz', hf', hs'])

def BadColoring (F : Finset (Finset X)) (w : Finset X → X → ℝ) (a : Coloring X s) : Prop :=
  ¬ ∃ H ∈ F, ∀ i : Fin s, 1-deficit i ≤ ∑ x ∈ initial a i, w H x

theorem feasible_unchanged_not_bad {F : Finset (Finset X)} {w : Finset X → X → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ H ∈ F, ∑ x, w H x = 1) (a : Coloring X s) (h : Feasible F w a a) :
    ¬ BadColoring F w a := by
  intro hb
  apply hb
  obtain ⟨H, hH, he⟩ := h
  refine ⟨H, hH, ?_⟩
  intro i
  obtain ⟨ε, hε⟩ := he i
  have hc : crossings a a i = ∅ := by ext x; simp [crossings]
  have ht := truncSum_untruncated (w H) (initial a i) (deficit i) ε
    (hw H hH) (deficit_pos i).le hε.2.2.1
  have h0 := hε.2.2.2
  rw [hc] at h0
  simp only [card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul] at h0
  linarith

theorem bad_minimal_changed_nonempty {F : Finset (Finset X)} {w : Finset X → X → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ H ∈ F, ∑ x, w H x = 1) {a z : Coloring X s}
    (ha : BadColoring F w a) (hz : MinimalMove F w a z) : (changed a z).Nonempty := by
  by_contra hn
  have he : z = a := by
    funext x
    apply le_antisymm (hz.1 x)
    by_contra h
    exact hn ⟨x, by simp [changed, lt_of_not_ge h]⟩
  subst z
  exact feasible_unchanged_not_bad hw a hz.2.1 ha

theorem not_small_minimal_cover {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    {F : Finset (Finset X)} {w : Finset X → X → ℝ}
    (hF : ¬ Small p F) (hw : ∀ H ∈ F, ∀ x, 0 ≤ w H x)
    (hsupp : ∀ H ∈ F, ∀ x ∉ H, w H x = 0) (a : Coloring X s) :
    (1:ℝ)/2 < ∑ z : Coloring X s, if MinimalMove F w a z then p^(changed a z).card else 0 := by
  let Z := univ.filter (MinimalMove F w a)
  let G := Z.image (changed a)
  have hcover : Covers G F := by
    intro H hH
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hsub⟩ := exists_minimal_move hw hsupp a hH
    exact ⟨changed a z, mem_image.mpr ⟨z, by simp [Z, hz], rfl⟩, hsub⟩
  have hcost : coverCost p G ≤
      ∑ z : Coloring X s, if MinimalMove F w a z then p^(changed a z).card else 0 := by
    have h := Finset.sum_image_le_of_nonneg (s := Z) (g := changed a)
      (f := fun S : Finset X => p^S.card) (fun S _ => pow_nonneg hp _)
    simpa [coverCost, G, Z, Finset.sum_filter] using h
  by_contra hn
  exact hF ⟨G, hcover, hcost.trans (le_of_not_gt hn)⟩

end
end TalagrandIntegral

import TalagrandIntegral.Expectation set_option autoImplicit false open Finset Classical namespace TalagrandIntegral noncomputable section variable {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] /-- The constant in Theorem 1.1 of small-vs-weakly-small.pdf. -/ def comparisonConstant : ℝ := 25*(512:ℝ)^4 theorem comparisonConstant_pos : 0 < comparisonConstant := by norm_num [comparisonConstant] theorem comparisonConstant_ge_one : 1 ≤ comparisonConstant := by norm_num [comparisonConstant] theorem small_zero_of_empty_not_mem {F : Finset (Finset X)} (hF : ∅ ∉ F) : Small 0 F := by refine ⟨F, fun H hH => ⟨H,hH,Finset.Subset.refl H⟩, ?_⟩ have he : coverCost 0 F = 0 := by apply Finset.sum_eq_zero intro S hS exact zero_pow (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (fun h => hF (h ▸ hS)))) rw [he]; norm_num theorem FractionalCover.empty_not_mem {r : ℝ} (hr : 0≤r) {F : Finset (Finset X)} {g : Finset X → ℝ} (hg : FractionalCover r F g) : ∅ ∉ F := by intro he have hm := fractional_mass hr hg he norm_num [subsetMass, nonemptySubsets] at hm /-- Budget-preserving integral rounding, the explicit stronger form of Theorem 1.1 in small-vs-weakly-small.pdf. All proof dependencies are checked. -/ theorem fractional_to_integral {r : ℝ} (hr : 0≤r) {F : Finset (Finset X)} {g : Finset X → ℝ} (hg : FractionalCover r F g) : Small (r/comparisonConstant) F := by by_cases hr0 : r=0 · simpa [hr0] using small_zero_of_empty_not_mem (hg.empty_not_mem hr) have hrp : 0(colorProb_pos hp hs c).le) (fun c=>(colorY_pos c).le) hm' linarith /-- Supremum formulation of the integral expectation threshold. -/ def integralThreshold (F : Finset (Finset X)) : ℝ := sSup {p : ℝ | p∈Set.Icc 0 1 ∧ Small p F} /-- Supremum formulation of the fractional expectation threshold. -/ def fractionalThreshold (F : Finset (Finset X)) : ℝ := sSup {r : ℝ | r∈Set.Icc 0 1 ∧ ∃g, FractionalCover r F g} theorem integralThreshold_nonneg {F : Finset (Finset X)} (hF : ∅ ∉ F) : 0 ≤ integralThreshold F := by apply le_csSup (show BddAbove {p : ℝ | p∈Set.Icc 0 1 ∧ Small p F} from ⟨1,fun p hp=>hp.1.2⟩) exact ⟨⟨le_rfl,by norm_num⟩,small_zero_of_empty_not_mem hF⟩ /-- The threshold inequality in Theorem 1.1. No monotonicity of the family is needed for this stronger form; exclusion of the empty set suffices. -/ theorem comparison_theorem_1_1 {F : Finset (Finset X)} (hF : ∅ ∉ F) : fractionalThreshold F ≤ comparisonConstant*integralThreshold F := by have hq0 := integralThreshold_nonneg hF by_cases he : {r : ℝ | r∈Set.Icc 0 1 ∧ ∃g, FractionalCover r F g}.Nonempty · apply csSup_le he intro r hr obtain ⟨hr, g,hg⟩ := hr have hsmall := fractional_to_integral hr.1 hg have hq : r/comparisonConstant ≤ integralThreshold F := by apply le_csSup (show BddAbove {p : ℝ | p∈Set.Icc 0 1 ∧ Small p F} from ⟨1,fun p hp=>hp.1.2⟩) refine ⟨⟨div_nonneg hr.1 comparisonConstant_pos.le,?_⟩,hsmall⟩ exact (div_le_one comparisonConstant_pos).mpr (hr.2.trans comparisonConstant_ge_one) have hmul := (div_le_iff₀ comparisonConstant_pos).mp hq simpa only [mul_comm] using hmul · have hempty : {r : ℝ | r∈Set.Icc 0 1 ∧ ∃g, FractionalCover r F g} = ∅ := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp he rw [fractionalThreshold,hempty,Real.sSup_empty] exact mul_nonneg comparisonConstant_pos.le hq0 end end TalagrandIntegral

import TalagrandIntegral.Reconstruction
import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.ExponentialBounds

set_option autoImplicit false

open Finset Classical
namespace TalagrandIntegral
noncomputable section
variable {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] {s t : ℕ}

theorem sum_comp_le {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (f : A → B) (hf : Function.Injective f) (g : B → ℝ) (hg : ∀ b, 0 ≤ g b) :
    (∑ a, g (f a)) ≤ ∑ b, g b := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_image (fun a _ b _ h => hf h)]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
    (fun b _ _ => hg b)

def moveWeight (p : ℝ) (π : Fin (s+1) → ℝ) (m : MoveType s) : ℝ :=
  p * π m.val.2 / π m.val.1
def moveRate (p : ℝ) (π : Fin (s+1) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ m : MoveType s, (2:ℝ)^(m.val.1.val+1)*moveWeight p π m

theorem moveWeight_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) {π : Fin (s+1) → ℝ}
    (hπ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ π i) (m : MoveType s) : 0 ≤ moveWeight p π m := by
  exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hp (hπ m.val.2)) (hπ m.val.1)

theorem mass_moveWord {p : ℝ} (π : Fin (s+1) → ℝ) (hπ : ∀ i, 0 < π i)
    {a z : Coloring X s} (hza : z ≤ a) (e : Fin t ≃ ↥(changed a z)) :
    productMass π a * p^t = productMass π z * ∏ j, moveWeight p π (moveWord e j) := by
  have hpoint (x : X) : π (a x) = π (z x) *
      (if z x < a x then π (a x)/π (z x) else 1) := by
    by_cases hx : z x < a x
    · rw [if_pos hx]; field_simp [ne_of_gt (hπ (z x))]
    · have he : a x = z x := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hx) (hza x)
      simp [hx, he]
  have he : (∏ j : Fin t, π (a (e j))/π (z (e j))) =
      ∏ x ∈ changed a z, π (a x)/π (z x) := by
    rw [e.prod_comp (fun x : ↥(changed a z) => π (a x)/π (z x))]
    exact Finset.prod_coe_sort (changed a z) (fun x : X => π (a x)/π (z x))
  have hm : productMass π a = productMass π z *
      ∏ x ∈ changed a z, π (a x)/π (z x) := by
    unfold productMass
    conv_lhs => arg 2; ext x; rw [hpoint x]
    rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    congr 1
    simp only [changed, Finset.prod_filter]
  rw [hm, ← he]
  simp only [moveWeight, moveWord, mul_div_assoc, Finset.prod_mul_distrib,
    Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_fin]
  ring

/-- The factorial bound needed for ordered encodings, obtained from one
nonnegative term of the exponential series. -/
theorem factorial_bound (t : ℕ) : (t:ℝ)^t / (t.factorial:ℝ) ≤ (3:ℝ)^t := by
  have h := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (t:ℝ) (show (0:ℝ) ≤ t by positivity) t
  have he : Real.exp (t:ℝ) = (Real.exp 1)^t := by
    simpa using Real.exp_nat_mul 1 t
  rw [he] at h
  exact h.trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.exp_pos 1).le Real.exp_one_lt_three.le _)

/-- The cost of all minimal moves into a fixed final coloring, at fixed
nonzero cardinality. This is the grouped estimate underlying (2.13)--(2.14). -/
theorem fixed_cardinality_count {F : Finset (Finset X)} {w : Finset X → X → ℝ}
    (hw0 : ∀ H ∈ F, ∀ x, 0 ≤ w H x) (hw1 : ∀ H ∈ F, ∑ x, w H x = 1)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (π : Fin (s+1) → ℝ) (hπ : ∀ i, 0 < π i)
    (z : Coloring X s) (t : ℕ) :
    (∑ a : Coloring X s, if MinimalMove F w a z ∧ (changed a z).card = t
      then productMass π a*p^t else 0) ≤
        productMass π z * (3*moveRate p π)^t := by
  let A := {a : Coloring X s // MinimalMove F w a z ∧ (changed a z).card = t}
  let E := (a : A) × (Fin t ≃ ↥(changed a.val z))
  let U := Fin t → MoveType s
  have hsets (u : U) := common_candidate_sets hw0 hw1 z u
  choose R hR hc using hsets
  let B := (u : U) × ((j : Fin t) → ↥(R u j))
  let code : E → B := fun ⟨a, e⟩ => ⟨moveWord e, fun j =>
    ⟨(e j).val, hc (moveWord e) a.val a.property.1 e rfl j⟩⟩
  have hcode : Function.Injective code := by
    rintro ⟨a,e⟩ ⟨b,f⟩ he
    have hword : moveWord e = moveWord f := congrArg Sigma.fst he
    have hpos (j : Fin t) : (e j).val = (f j).val :=
      congrArg (fun q : B => (q.2 j).val) he
    have hab : a = b := Subtype.ext (word_reconstructs a.property.1.1 b.property.1.1 e f hword hpos)
    subst b
    have hef : e = f := by ext j; exact hpos j
    subst f
    rfl
  let W : U → ℝ := fun u => productMass π z * ∏ j, moveWeight p π (u j)
  have hW (u : U) : 0 ≤ W u := by
    apply mul_nonneg (productMass_nonneg (fun i => (hπ i).le) z)
    exact Finset.prod_nonneg (fun j _ => moveWeight_nonneg hp (fun i => (hπ i).le) (u j))
  have hsum := sum_comp_le code hcode (fun q : B => W q.1) (fun q => hW q.1)
  have hcard (a : A) : Fintype.card (Fin t ≃ ↥(changed a.val z)) = t.factorial := by
    have heq : Fintype.card (Fin t) = Fintype.card ↥(changed a.val z) := by
      simpa using a.property.2.symm
    simpa using Fintype.card_equiv (Fintype.equivOfCardEq heq)
  have hleft : (∑ e : E, W (code e).1) =
      (t.factorial:ℝ) * ∑ a : A, productMass π a.val*p^t := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
    simp only [code, W]
    have hh (a : A) (e : Fin t ≃ ↥(changed a.val z)) := mass_moveWord (p := p) π hπ a.property.1.1 e
    simp_rw [← hh]
    simp [hcard, nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  have hright : (∑ b : B, W b.1) ≤
      productMass π z * (t:ℝ)^t * (moveRate p π)^t := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hprod (u : U) : (Fintype.card ((j : Fin t) → ↥(R u j)) : ℝ) ≤
        ∏ j, (t:ℝ)*(2:ℝ)^((u j).val.1.val+1) := by
      simp only [Fintype.card_pi, Fintype.card_coe, Nat.cast_prod]
      exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun j _ => by positivity) (fun j _ => hR u j)
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ u : U, (∏ j, (t:ℝ)*(2:ℝ)^((u j).val.1.val+1)) * W u :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun u _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hprod u) (hW u))
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [W, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_fin]
        have hword : (∑ u : U, (∏ j, (2:ℝ)^((u j).val.1.val+1)) *
            ∏ j, moveWeight p π (u j)) = (moveRate p π)^t := by
          simp only [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
          rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun (_ : Fin t) m => (2:ℝ)^(m.val.1.val+1)*moveWeight p π m)]
          simp [moveRate]
        calc
          _ = productMass π z * (t:ℝ)^t *
              (∑ u : U, (∏ j, (2:ℝ)^((u j).val.1.val+1)) * ∏ j, moveWeight p π (u j)) := by
            simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro u _; ring
          _ = _ := by rw [hword]
  rw [hleft] at hsum
  have hbound := hsum.trans hright
  have hf : (0:ℝ) < t.factorial := by positivity
  have hdiv : (∑ a : A, productMass π a.val*p^t) ≤
      productMass π z*(t:ℝ)^t*(moveRate p π)^t/(t.factorial:ℝ) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hf).mpr
    nlinarith [hbound]
  have hn : 0 ≤ productMass π z * (moveRate p π)^t := by
    apply mul_nonneg (productMass_nonneg (fun i => (hπ i).le) z)
    apply pow_nonneg
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun m _ => mul_nonneg (by positivity) (moveWeight_nonneg hp (fun i => (hπ i).le) m))
  have hfac := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (factorial_bound t) hn
  have hfinal : (∑ a : A, productMass π a.val*p^t) ≤ productMass π z*(3*moveRate p π)^t := by
    calc
      _ ≤ productMass π z*(t:ℝ)^t*(moveRate p π)^t/(t.factorial:ℝ) := hdiv
      _ = (productMass π z*(moveRate p π)^t)*((t:ℝ)^t/(t.factorial:ℝ)) := by ring
      _ ≤ (productMass π z*(moveRate p π)^t)*(3:ℝ)^t := hfac
      _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow]; ring
  have he : (∑ a : Coloring X s, if MinimalMove F w a z ∧ (changed a z).card = t
      then productMass π a*p^t else 0) = ∑ a : A, productMass π a.val*p^t := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    exact Finset.sum_subtype _ (by simp) _
  rw [he]
  exact hfinal

end
end TalagrandIntegral

import TalagrandIntegral.FiniteProbability

set_option autoImplicit false

open Finset Classical
namespace TalagrandIntegral
noncomputable section
open TalagrandConjectures
variable {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] {L : ℕ}

def labelProb (L : ℕ) (u v : ℝ) (c : Fin (L+1)) : ℝ := if c=0 then u else v

theorem labelProb_sum (L : ℕ) (u v : ℝ) : (∑c,labelProb L u v c) = u+L*v := by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp [labelProb]

theorem labelProb_nonneg (L : ℕ) {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0≤u) (hv : 0≤v) (c : Fin (L+1)) :
    0≤labelProb L u v c := by unfold labelProb; split_ifs <;> assumption

def sparseRow (j : Fin L) (c : Fin (L+1)) : Bool := decide (c=j.succ)
def denseRow (j : Fin L) (c : Fin (L+1)) : Bool := decide (c=0 ∨ c=j.succ)
def sparseUnion (c : Fin (L+1)) : Bool := decide (c≠0)

theorem sparseRow_prob (u v : ℝ) (j : Fin L) :
    (∑c,if sparseRow j c=true then labelProb L u v c else 0) = v := by
  simp [sparseRow,labelProb]

theorem denseRow_prob (u v : ℝ) (j : Fin L) :
    (∑c,if denseRow j c=true then labelProb L u v c else 0) = u+v := by
  have he (c : Fin (L+1)) : (if denseRow j c=true then labelProb L u v c else 0) =
      (if c=0 then u else 0)+(if c=j.succ then v else 0) := by
    by_cases hc : c=0
    · subst c; simp [denseRow,labelProb, Ne.symm j.succ_ne_zero]
    · simp [denseRow,labelProb,hc]
  simp_rw [he]
  simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

theorem sparseUnion_prob (u v : ℝ) :
    (∑c : Fin (L+1),if sparseUnion c=true then labelProb L u v c else 0) = L*v := by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp [sparseUnion,labelProb]

theorem sparse_union (a : X→Fin (L+1)) :
    unionOf (fun j x=>sparseRow j (a x)) = fun x=>sparseUnion (a x) := by
  funext x
  by_cases hx : a x=0
  · simp only [unionOf,sparseRow,sparseUnion,hx,fun j : Fin L=>Ne.symm j.succ_ne_zero,
      ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,decide_false]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Finset.sup_le
      intro j _
      exact le_rfl
    · exact bot_le
  · obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := Fin.exists_succ_eq.mpr hx
    have ht : (true:Bool) ≤ unionOf (fun j x=>sparseRow j (a x)) x := by
      have h := Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : Fin L=>sparseRow j (a x)) (Finset.mem_univ j)
      simpa [sparseRow,hj,unionOf] using h
    have he : unionOf (fun j x=>sparseRow j (a x)) x = true := top_unique ht
    simp only [sparseUnion,ne_eq,hx,not_false_eq_true,decide_true]
    exact he

theorem dense_union (hL : 0<L) (a : X→Fin (L+1)) :
    unionOf (fun j x=>denseRow j (a x)) = ⊤ := by
  funext x
  have hrow : ∃j : Fin L,denseRow j (a x)=true := by
    by_cases hx : a x=0
    · exact ⟨⟨0,hL⟩,by simp [denseRow,hx]⟩
    · obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := Fin.exists_succ_eq.mpr hx
      exact ⟨j,by simp [denseRow,hj]⟩
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hrow
  have ht : (true:Bool) ≤ unionOf (fun j x=>denseRow j (a x)) x := by
    have h := Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : Fin L=>denseRow j (a x)) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    simpa only [unionOf,hj] using h
  have he : unionOf (fun j x=>denseRow j (a x)) x = true := top_unique ht
  exact he

def unionFamily (L : ℕ) (D : Set (Cube X)) : Set (Cube X) :=
  {J | ∃f : Fin L→Cube X,(∀j,f j∈D) ∧ J=unionOf f}

theorem sparse_density_boost {p δ : ℝ} (hp : 0≤p) (hLp : (L:ℝ)*p≤1)
    (D : Set (Cube X)) (hD : 1-δ≤measure p D) :
    1-(L:ℝ)*δ ≤ measure ((L:ℝ)*p) (unionFamily L D) := by
  let π := labelProb L (1-(L:ℝ)*p) p
  have hπ0 (c) : 0≤π c := labelProb_nonneg L (by linarith) hp c
  have hπ1 : (∑c,π c)=1 := by rw [labelProb_sum]; ring
  have hrow (j : Fin L) : (∑a : X→Fin (L+1),if (fun x=>sparseRow j (a x))∈D then productMass π a else 0) = measure p D :=
    productMass_bernoulli hπ1 (sparseRow j) (sparseRow_prob _ _ j) D
  have hall := finite_union_bound (fun a : X→Fin (L+1)=>productMass π a)
    (productMass_nonneg hπ0) (productMass_sum π hπ1)
    (fun j : Fin L=>fun a=>(fun x=>sparseRow j (a x))∈D) δ (fun j=>by rw [hrow]; exact hD)
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hall
  have hu := productMass_bernoulli (X:=X) hπ1 sparseUnion (sparseUnion_prob (1-(L:ℝ)*p) p) (unionFamily L D)
  rw [← hu]
  refine hall.trans (Finset.sum_le_sum ?_)
  intro a _
  by_cases ha : ∀j : Fin L,(fun x=>sparseRow j (a x))∈D
  · have hf : (fun x=>sparseUnion (a x))∈unionFamily L D :=
      ⟨(fun j x=>sparseRow j (a x)),ha,(sparse_union a).symm⟩
    simp [ha,hf]
  · simp only [if_neg ha]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | exact productMass_nonneg hπ0 a

theorem dense_full_union {p δ : ℝ} (hL : 1<L) (hp1 : p≤1) (hLp : 1≤(L:ℝ)*p)
    (hδ : (L:ℝ)*δ<1) (D : Set (Cube X)) (hD : 1-δ≤measure p D) :
    ∃f : Fin L→Cube X,(∀j,f j∈D) ∧ unionOf f=⊤ := by
  let u := ((L:ℝ)*p-1)/((L:ℝ)-1)
  let v := (1-p)/((L:ℝ)-1)
  have hLr : (1:ℝ)<L := by exact_mod_cast hL
  have hd : (L:ℝ)-1≠0 := by linarith
  have hu : 0≤u := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hv : 0≤v := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  let π := labelProb L u v
  have hπ0 (c) : 0≤π c := labelProb_nonneg L hu hv c
  have hπ1 : (∑c,π c)=1 := by rw [labelProb_sum]; dsimp [u,v]; field_simp [hd]; ring
  have hp : u+v=p := by dsimp [u,v]; field_simp [hd]; ring
  have hrow (j : Fin L) : (∑a : X→Fin (L+1),if (fun x=>denseRow j (a x))∈D then productMass π a else 0) = measure p D := by
    apply productMass_bernoulli hπ1 (denseRow j)
    rw [denseRow_prob,hp]
  have hall := finite_union_bound (fun a : X→Fin (L+1)=>productMass π a)
    (productMass_nonneg hπ0) (productMass_sum π hπ1)
    (fun j : Fin L=>fun a=>(fun x=>denseRow j (a x))∈D) δ (fun j=>by rw [hrow]; exact hD)
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hall
  have hex : ∃a : X→Fin (L+1),∀j : Fin L,(fun x=>denseRow j (a x))∈D := by
    by_contra hn
    have hzero : 1-(L:ℝ)*δ ≤ 0 := hall.trans (by
      apply Finset.sum_nonpos
      intro a _
      split_ifs with h
      · exact (hn ⟨a,h⟩).elim
      · exact le_rfl)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hex
  exact ⟨(fun j x=>denseRow j (a x)),ha,dense_union (by omega) a⟩

end
end TalagrandIntegral

import TalagrandIntegral.Comparison
import TalagrandConjectures.Li

set_option autoImplicit false

open Finset Classical
namespace TalagrandIntegral
noncomputable section
variable {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]

/-- Explicit equivalence between finite subsets and the Boolean cube. -/
def finsetCube : Finset X ≃ TalagrandConjectures.Cube X where
  toFun S x := decide (x∈S)
  invFun J := univ.filter (fun x=>J x=true)
  left_inv S := by ext x; simp
  right_inv J := by funext x; simp

theorem finsetCube_le {S T : Finset X} : finsetCube S ≤ finsetCube T ↔ S⊆T := by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    have hh := h x
    by_cases ht : x∈T
    · exact ht
    · simp only [finsetCube, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, hx, ht, decide_true, decide_false] at hh
      exact ((by decide : ¬ (true:Bool) ≤ false) hh).elim
  · intro h x
    by_cases hx : x∈S
    · simp [finsetCube,hx,h hx]
    · simp [finsetCube,hx]

theorem monoWeight_finsetCube (r : ℝ) (S : Finset X) :
    TalagrandConjectures.monoWeight r (finsetCube S) = r^S.card := by
  simp only [TalagrandConjectures.monoWeight, finsetCube, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, decide_eq_true_eq]
  rw [← Finset.prod_filter]
  simp

def cubeFamily (A : Set (TalagrandConjectures.Cube X)) : Finset (Finset X) :=
  univ.filter (fun S=>finsetCube S ∈ A)

def IntegralSmall (r : ℝ) (A : Set (TalagrandConjectures.Cube X)) : Prop := Small r (cubeFamily A)

theorem cap_sum_ge_one {I : Type} [DecidableEq I] (E : Finset I) (f : I→ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i∈E, 0≤f i) (hs : 1≤∑i∈E,f i) : 1≤∑i∈E,min 1 (f i) := by
  by_cases he : ∃i∈E,1≤f i
  · obtain ⟨i,hi,hi1⟩ := he
    have h := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i=>min 1 (f i))
      (fun i hi=>le_min (by norm_num) (hf i hi)) hi
    simpa [min_eq_left hi1] using h
  · have hpoint (i) (hi : i∈E) : min 1 (f i) = f i := by
      apply min_eq_right
      by_contra h
      exact he ⟨i,hi,le_of_not_ge h⟩
    simpa only [Finset.sum_congr rfl hpoint] using hs

theorem weaklySmall_fractional {r : ℝ} (hr : 0≤r)
    {A : Set (TalagrandConjectures.Cube X)} (h : TalagrandConjectures.WeaklySmall r A) :
    ∃g, FractionalCover r (cubeFamily A) g := by
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hcost,hcover⟩ := h
  let g : Finset X → ℝ := fun S=>min 1 (c (finsetCube S))
  refine ⟨g, (fun S=>⟨le_min (by norm_num) (hc _),min_le_left _ _⟩), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro H hH
    have hJ : finsetCube H∈A := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hH).2
    have he : (∑ S∈H.powerset,c (finsetCube S)) =
        ∑I : TalagrandConjectures.Cube X,if I≤finsetCube H then c I else 0 := by
      rw [← Equiv.sum_comp finsetCube (fun I=>if I≤finsetCube H then c I else 0)]
      simp_rw [finsetCube_le]
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
      congr 1
      ext S; simp
    exact cap_sum_ge_one H.powerset (fun S=>c (finsetCube S)) (fun S _=>hc _) (he ▸ hcover _ hJ)
  · calc
      (∑S,g S*r^S.card) ≤ ∑S,c (finsetCube S)*TalagrandConjectures.monoWeight r (finsetCube S) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro S _
        rw [monoWeight_finsetCube]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) (pow_nonneg hr _)
      _ = ∑I,c I*TalagrandConjectures.monoWeight r I := Equiv.sum_comp (finsetCube (X:=X)) (fun I=>c I*TalagrandConjectures.monoWeight r I)
      _ ≤ 1/2 := hcost

theorem weaklySmall_integral {r : ℝ} (hr : 0≤r)
    {A : Set (TalagrandConjectures.Cube X)} (h : TalagrandConjectures.WeaklySmall r A) :
    IntegralSmall (r/comparisonConstant) A := by
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := weaklySmall_fractional hr h
  exact fractional_to_integral hr hg

theorem IntegralSmall.mono {r : ℝ} {A B : Set (TalagrandConjectures.Cube X)}
    (h : IntegralSmall r A) (hBA : B⊆A) : IntegralSmall r B := by
  apply h.mono_family
  intro S hS
  exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,hBA (Finset.mem_filter.mp hS).2⟩

theorem IntegralSmall.mono_density {p r : ℝ} (hp : 0≤p) (hpr : p≤r)
    {A : Set (TalagrandConjectures.Cube X)} (h : IntegralSmall r A) : IntegralSmall p A :=
  Small.mono_density hp hpr h

/-- Corollary 4.1 in small-vs-weakly-small.pdf, equivalently Corollary 1.2
in Talagrand-discrete-convexity-conjecture.pdf. The weak inequality at density
one half is included. -/
theorem integral_two_unions {p : ℝ} (hp : 0<p) (hp1 : p<1)
    (A : Set (TalagrandConjectures.Cube X)) (hm : (1:ℝ)/2 ≤ TalagrandConjectures.measure p A) :
    IntegralSmall (p/(50*(512:ℝ)^4)) (TalagrandConjectures.badTwo A) := by
  have h := weaklySmall_integral (show 0≤p/2 by positivity)
    (TalagrandConjectures.li_weaklySmall_badTwo_half hp hp1 A hm)
  have he : p/(50*(512:ℝ)^4) = p/2/comparisonConstant := by norm_num [comparisonConstant]; ring
  rw [he]; exact h

end
end TalagrandIntegral

import TalagrandIntegral.Grouping

set_option autoImplicit false

open Finset Classical
namespace TalagrandIntegral
noncomputable section
open TalagrandConjectures
variable {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]

/-- The same-density conclusion from a general two-union rounding constant.
The sparse and dense couplings are constructed in `Couplings.lean`. -/
theorem discrete_convexity_general {L k : ℕ} (hL : 1<L) (hLk : 2*L≤k)
    (hconstant : 50*(512:ℝ)^4 ≤ L) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0<p) (hp1 : p<1)
    (D : Set (Cube X)) (hD : 1-1/(k:ℝ) ≤ measure p D) :
    IntegralSmall p (badUnions k D) := by
  have hL0 : 0<L := by omega
  have hk0 : 0<k := by omega
  have hLr : (0:ℝ)<L := by exact_mod_cast hL0
  have hkr : (0:ℝ)<k := by exact_mod_cast hk0
  have hratio : (L:ℝ)*(1/(k:ℝ)) ≤ 1/2 := by
    rw [mul_one_div,div_le_iff₀ hkr]
    have hcast : (2:ℝ)*L≤k := by exact_mod_cast hLk
    linarith
  by_cases hLp : (L:ℝ)*p<1
  · have hdens := sparse_density_boost hp.le hLp.le D hD
    have hhalf : (1:ℝ)/2 ≤ measure ((L:ℝ)*p) (unionFamily L D) := by linarith
    have hsmall := integral_two_unions (mul_pos hLr hp) hLp (unionFamily L D) hhalf
    have hpbound : p ≤ ((L:ℝ)*p)/(50*(512:ℝ)^4) := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<50*(512:ℝ)^4)).mpr
      nlinarith
    exact (hsmall.mono_density hp.le hpbound).mono (badUnions_subset_badTwo_unionFamily hL0 hLk D)
  · have hfull := dense_full_union hL hp1.le (le_of_not_gt hLp)
      (by linarith : (L:ℝ)*(1/(k:ℝ))<1) D hD
    rw [badUnions_empty_of_full_tuple hL0 (by omega : L≤k) hfull]
    exact integralSmall_empty p

/-- Theorem 1.1 of Talagrand-discrete-convexity-conjecture.pdf, with exactly
k = 2^75 and covering cost at most 1/2 at the original density p. The proof
uses the companion comparison theorem followed by the density-boosting
argument; it does not assume the paper's hypergraph-covering lemma. -/
theorem discrete_convexity_theorem_1_1 {p : ℝ} (hp : 0<p) (hp1 : p<1)
    (D : Set (Cube X)) (hD : 1-1/((2:ℝ)^75) ≤ measure p D) :
    IntegralSmall p (badUnions (2^75) D) := by
  apply discrete_convexity_general (L:=2^70) (k:=2^75)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hp hp1 D
  norm_num at hD ⊢
  exact hD

/-- Proposition 3.1, obtained using the proved comparison theorem and the
fractional two-union certificate. -/
theorem discrete_convexity_proposition_3_1 {q : ℝ} (hq : 0<q) (hq1 : q<1)
    (F : Set (Cube X)) (hF : (1:ℝ)/2≤measure q F) :
    IntegralSmall (q/((2:ℝ)^70)) (badUnions 32 F) := by
  have htwo := integral_two_unions hq hq1 F hF
  have hsub : badUnions 32 F ⊆ badTwo F := by
    intro J hJ
    rintro ⟨Y,hY,Z,hZ,hcov⟩
    let f : Fin 2→Cube X := fun j=>if j.val=0 then Y else Z
    have hf : ∀j,f j∈F := by intro j; dsimp [f]; split_ifs <;> assumption
    obtain ⟨g,hg,hgcover⟩ := pad_tuple (by norm_num : 0<2) (by norm_num : 2≤32) f hf
    apply hJ
    refine ⟨g,hg,?_⟩
    intro x
    apply (hcov x).trans
    change Y x ⊔ Z x ≤ unionOf g x
    apply sup_le
    · have h := Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : Fin 2=>f j x) (Finset.mem_univ (0:Fin 2))
      have hh : Y x ≤ unionOf f x := by simpa [f,unionOf] using h
      exact hh.trans (hgcover x)
    · have h := Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : Fin 2=>f j x) (Finset.mem_univ (1:Fin 2))
      have hh : Z x ≤ unionOf f x := by simpa [f,unionOf] using h
      exact hh.trans (hgcover x)
  have hrad : q/((2:ℝ)^70) ≤ q/(50*(512:ℝ)^4) := by
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hq.le (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  exact (htwo.mono_density (by positivity) hrad).mono hsub

end
end TalagrandIntegral

import TalagrandIntegral.Polynomial

set_option autoImplicit false

open Finset Classical
namespace TalagrandIntegral
noncomputable section
variable {X C : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype C]

theorem productMass_subset (π Y : C → ℝ) (hπ : ∑ c,π c=1) (S : Finset X) :
    (∑ a : X→C, productMass π a * ∏x∈S,Y (a x)) = (∑c,π c*Y c)^S.card := by
  have he (a : X→C) : (∏x, if x∈S then Y (a x) else 1) = ∏x∈S,Y (a x) := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_filter]; simp
  have h := productMass_factor π (fun x c => if x∈S then Y c else 1)
  simp_rw [he] at h
  rw [h]
  have hf (x : X) : (∑c,π c*(if x∈S then Y c else 1)) = if x∈S then (∑c,π c*Y c) else 1 := by
    by_cases hx : x∈S <;> simp [hx,hπ]
  simp_rw [hf]
  rw [← Finset.prod_filter]
  simp

theorem expectation_polynomial (π Y : C → ℝ) (hπ : ∑ c,π c=1) (g : Finset X → ℝ) :
    (∑a : X→C,productMass π a * coverPolynomial g (fun x=>Y (a x))) =
      ∑S∈nonemptySubsets (univ : Finset X),g S*(∑c,π c*Y c)^S.card := by
  unfold coverPolynomial
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro S _
  calc
    _ = g S * ∑a : X→C,productMass π a*∏x∈S,Y (a x) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _; ring
    _ = _ := by rw [productMass_subset π Y hπ S]

theorem expectation_polynomial_upper {r : ℝ} (hr : 0≤r) {F : Finset (Finset X)}
    {g : Finset X → ℝ} (hg : FractionalCover r F g) (π Y : C → ℝ)
    (hπ : ∑c,π c=1) (hπ0 : ∀c,0≤π c) (hY0 : ∀c,0≤Y c)
    (hmean : (∑c,π c*Y c) ≤ r/5) :
    (∑a : X→C,productMass π a*coverPolynomial g (fun x=>Y (a x))) ≤ 1/10 := by
  rw [expectation_polynomial π Y hπ]
  have hm0 : 0≤∑c,π c*Y c := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun c _ => mul_nonneg (hπ0 c) (hY0 c))
  have hp (S : Finset X) (hS : S∈nonemptySubsets (univ : Finset X)) :
      (∑c,π c*Y c)^S.card ≤ (1/5:ℝ)*r^S.card := by
    have hc : 0<S.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr (mem_nonemptySubsets.mp hS).1
    calc
      _ ≤ (r/5)^S.card := pow_le_pow_left₀ hm0 hmean _
      _ = r^S.card*(1/5:ℝ)^S.card := by rw [← mul_pow]; congr 1; ring
      _ ≤ r^S.card*(1/5:ℝ) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (pow_nonneg hr _)
        calc
          (1/5:ℝ)^S.card ≤ (1/5:ℝ)^1 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hc
          _ = _ := pow_one _
      _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑S∈nonemptySubsets (univ : Finset X),(1/5:ℝ)*(g S*r^S.card) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro S hS
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hp S hS) (hg.1 S).1
      nlinarith
    _ = (1/5:ℝ)*∑S∈nonemptySubsets (univ : Finset X),g S*r^S.card := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ (1/5:ℝ)*∑S : Finset X,g S*r^S.card := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by norm_num)
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun S _ _ => mul_nonneg (hg.1 S).1 (pow_nonneg hr _))
    _ ≤ (1/5:ℝ)*(1/2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg.2.2 (by norm_num)
    _ = _ := by norm_num

theorem expectation_polynomial_lower {r : ℝ} (hr : 0≤r) {F : Finset (Finset X)}
    {g : Finset X → ℝ} (hg : FractionalCover r F g) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0<p)
    (hF : ¬Small p F) {s : ℕ} (hs : p*scaleSum s≤1/2) :
    (9:ℝ)/40 ≤ ∑a : Coloring X s,productMass (colorProb p s) a*
      coverPolynomial g (fun x=>colorY (a x)) := by
  obtain ⟨hw0,hw1,hsupp⟩ := fractional_weights hr hg
  have hevent := mean_selector hw0 hw1 hsupp hp hF hs
  have hP (a : Coloring X s) : 0≤productMass (colorProb p s) a :=
    productMass_nonneg (fun c => (colorProb_pos hp hs c).le) a
  have hpoint (a : Coloring X s) :
      (1/4:ℝ)*(if ∃H∈F,meanColor (subsetWeights g H) a≤2 then productMass (colorProb p s) a else 0) ≤
        productMass (colorProb p s) a*coverPolynomial g (fun x=>colorY (a x)) := by
    by_cases h : ∃H∈F,meanColor (subsetWeights g H) a≤2
    · simp only [if_pos h]
      obtain ⟨H,hH,hmean⟩ := h
      have hl := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (coverPolynomial_large hr hg a hH hmean) (hP a)
      simpa only [mul_comm (1/4:ℝ)] using hl
    · simp only [if_neg h,mul_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg (hP a) (coverPolynomial_nonneg (fun S => (hg.1 S).1) (fun x=>(colorY_pos _).le))
  have h := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := (univ : Finset (Coloring X s))) (fun a _ => hpoint a)
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at h
  linarith

end
end TalagrandIntegral

import TalagrandIntegral.CubeBridge

set_option autoImplicit false

open Finset Classical
namespace TalagrandIntegral
noncomputable section
variable {X C B : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype C] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]

def pushProb (π : C→ℝ) (φ : C→B) (b : B) : ℝ := ∑c,if φ c=b then π c else 0

theorem productMass_fiber (π : C→ℝ) (φ : C→B) (b : X→B) :
    (∑a : X→C, if (fun x=>φ (a x))=b then productMass π a else 0) =
      productMass (pushProb π φ) b := by
  have hd (a : X→C) : (∏x, if φ (a x)=b x then (1:ℝ) else 0) =
      if (fun x=>φ (a x))=b then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases h : (fun x=>φ (a x))=b
    · have hx (x) : φ (a x)=b x := congrFun h x
      simp [h,hx]
    · rw [if_neg h]
      obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ : ∃x,φ (a x)≠b x := by simpa only [not_forall, funext_iff] using h
      exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ x) (if_neg hx)
  have hf (x : X) : (∑c,π c*(if φ c=b x then (1:ℝ) else 0)) = pushProb π φ (b x) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro c _
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have h := productMass_factor π (fun x c=>if φ c=b x then 1 else 0)
  simp_rw [hd,hf,mul_ite,mul_one,mul_zero] at h
  exact h

theorem productMass_pushforward (π : C→ℝ) (φ : C→B) (f : (X→B)→ℝ) :
    (∑a : X→C,productMass π a*f (fun x=>φ (a x))) =
      ∑b : X→B,productMass (pushProb π φ) b*f b := by
  have he (a : X→C) : productMass π a*f (fun x=>φ (a x)) =
      ∑b : X→B,(if (fun x=>φ (a x))=b then productMass π a else 0)*f b := by
    simp [ite_mul]
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, productMass_fiber]

theorem pushProb_bool {π : C→ℝ} (hπ : ∑c,π c=1) (φ : C→Bool) {p : ℝ}
    (hp : (∑c,if φ c=true then π c else 0)=p) : pushProb π φ = TalagrandConjectures.bit p := by
  funext b
  cases b with
  | true => simpa [pushProb,TalagrandConjectures.bit] using hp
  | false =>
    have he : pushProb π φ false + pushProb π φ true = 1 := by
      rw [pushProb,pushProb,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      calc
        _ = ∑c,π c := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro c _; cases φ c <;> simp
        _ = 1 := hπ
    change pushProb π φ false = 1-p
    change pushProb π φ true = p at hp
    linarith

theorem productMass_bernoulli {π : C→ℝ} (hπ : ∑c,π c=1) (φ : C→Bool) {p : ℝ}
    (hp : (∑c,if φ c=true then π c else 0)=p) (A : Set (TalagrandConjectures.Cube X)) :
    (∑a : X→C, if (fun x=>φ (a x))∈A then productMass π a else 0) = TalagrandConjectures.measure p A := by
  have h := productMass_pushforward π φ (TalagrandConjectures.ind A)
  rw [pushProb_bool hπ φ hp] at h
  simpa [TalagrandConjectures.measure,TalagrandConjectures.avg,TalagrandConjectures.ind,
    TalagrandConjectures.mass,productMass,mul_ite] using h

theorem finite_union_bound {Ω J : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype J]
    (w : Ω→ℝ) (hw0 : ∀a,0≤w a) (hw1 : ∑a,w a=1) (P : J→Ω→Prop)
    (δ : ℝ) (hP : ∀j,(∑a,if P j a then w a else 0)≥1-δ) :
    (1:ℝ)-(Fintype.card J)*δ ≤ ∑a,if ∀j,P j a then w a else 0 := by
  have hp (a : Ω) : (if ∀j,P j a then (0:ℝ) else 1) ≤ ∑j,if P j a then (0:ℝ) else 1 := by
    by_cases ha : ∀j,P j a
    · simp [ha]
    · rw [if_neg ha]
      obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := not_forall.mp ha
      have h := Finset.single_le_sum (s := (univ : Finset J)) (f := fun j=>if P j a then (0:ℝ) else 1)
        (fun j _=>by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (Finset.mem_univ j)
      simpa [hj] using h
  have hmul (a : Ω) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hp a) (hw0 a)
  have h := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := (univ : Finset Ω)) (fun a _=>hmul a)
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum,mul_ite,mul_zero,mul_one] at h
  rw [Finset.sum_comm] at h
  have hc (Q : Ω→Prop) : (∑a,if Q a then 0 else w a) = 1-(∑a,if Q a then w a else 0) := by
    have he : (∑a,if Q a then 0 else w a)+(∑a,if Q a then w a else 0)=1 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      calc
        _ = ∑a,w a := by apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro a _; split_ifs <;> simp
        _ = 1 := hw1
    linarith
  have hsum : (∑j : J, ∑a : Ω,if P j a then 0 else w a) ≤ (Fintype.card J)*δ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑_ : J,δ := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _=>by linarith [hP j, hc (P j)])
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hall : (∑a : Ω,if ∀j,P j a then 0 else w a) +
      (∑a : Ω,if ∀j,P j a then w a else 0) = 1 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    calc
      _ = ∑a,w a := by apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro a _; split_ifs <;> simp
      _ = 1 := hw1
  linarith only [h,hsum,hall]

end
end TalagrandIntegral

import TalagrandIntegral.Couplings

set_option autoImplicit false

open Finset Classical
namespace TalagrandIntegral
noncomputable section
open TalagrandConjectures
variable {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]

theorem pad_tuple {n k : ℕ} (hn : 0<n) (hnk : n≤k) (f : Fin n→Cube X)
    {D : Set (Cube X)} (hf : ∀j,f j∈D) :
    ∃g : Fin k→Cube X,(∀j,g j∈D) ∧ unionOf f ≤ unionOf g := by
  let g : Fin k→Cube X := fun j=>f ⟨j.val%n,Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩
  refine ⟨g,(fun j=>hf _),?_⟩
  intro x
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro j _
  let j' : Fin k := ⟨j.val,lt_of_lt_of_le j.isLt hnk⟩
  have h := Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : Fin k=>g j x) (Finset.mem_univ j')
  simpa [g,j',Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt,unionOf] using h

theorem union_concat_left {L : ℕ} (f g : Fin L→Cube X) :
    unionOf f ≤ unionOf (Fin.addCases f g) := by
  intro x
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro j _
  have h := Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : Fin (L+L)=>(Fin.addCases f g j : Cube X) x) (Finset.mem_univ (Fin.castAdd L j))
  simpa only [Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right, unionOf] using h

theorem union_concat_right {L : ℕ} (f g : Fin L→Cube X) :
    unionOf g ≤ unionOf (Fin.addCases f g) := by
  intro x
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro j _
  have h := Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : Fin (L+L)=>(Fin.addCases f g j : Cube X) x) (Finset.mem_univ (Fin.natAdd L j))
  simpa only [Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right, unionOf] using h

theorem badUnions_subset_badTwo_unionFamily {L k : ℕ} (hL : 0<L) (hLk : 2*L≤k)
    (D : Set (Cube X)) : badUnions k D ⊆ badTwo (unionFamily L D) := by
  intro J hJ
  rintro ⟨Y,hY,Z,hZ,hcov⟩
  obtain ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩ := hY
  obtain ⟨g,hg,rfl⟩ := hZ
  have hfg : ∀j : Fin (L+L), Fin.addCases f g j∈D := by
    intro j
    refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ j
    · intro i; simpa only [Fin.addCases_left] using hf i
    · intro i; simpa only [Fin.addCases_right] using hg i
  obtain ⟨t,ht,htcov⟩ := pad_tuple (by omega : 0<L+L) (by omega : L+L≤k) (Fin.addCases f g) hfg
  apply hJ
  refine ⟨t,ht,?_⟩
  intro x
  apply (hcov x).trans
  change unionOf f x ⊔ unionOf g x ≤ unionOf t x
  exact sup_le ((union_concat_left f g x).trans (htcov x)) ((union_concat_right f g x).trans (htcov x))

theorem badUnions_empty_of_full_tuple {L k : ℕ} (hL : 0<L) (hLk : L≤k)
    {D : Set (Cube X)} (hfull : ∃f : Fin L→Cube X,(∀j,f j∈D) ∧ unionOf f=⊤) :
    badUnions k D = ∅ := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf,hfull⟩ := hfull
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hgfull⟩ := pad_tuple hL hLk f hf
  rw [hfull] at hgfull
  apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro J hJ
  exact hJ ⟨g,hg,le_top.trans hgfull⟩

theorem integralSmall_empty (p : ℝ) : IntegralSmall p (∅ : Set (Cube X)) := by
  simpa [IntegralSmall,cubeFamily] using small_empty (X:=X) p

end
end TalagrandIntegral

import TalagrandIntegral.Selector

set_option autoImplicit false

open Finset Classical
namespace TalagrandIntegral
noncomputable section
variable {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] {s : ℕ}

def meanColor (w : X → ℝ) (a : Coloring X s) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x, w x * ((a x).val+1)

theorem color_layers (c : Fin (s+1)) :
    (c.val+1:ℝ) = 1 + ∑ i : Fin s, if i.val<c.val then (1:ℝ) else 0 := by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => if i<c.val then (1:ℝ) else 0) s]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  have he : (range s).filter (fun i => i<c.val) = range c.val := by
    ext i; simp only [mem_filter, mem_range]; have hc := c.isLt; omega
  rw [he]; simp; ring

theorem meanColor_le_two (w : X → ℝ) (a : Coloring X s)
    (hw : ∑ x, w x = 1)
    (hcap : ∀ i : Fin s, 1-deficit i ≤ ∑ x ∈ initial a i, w x) :
    meanColor w a ≤ 2 := by
  have htail (i : Fin s) : (∑ x, w x*(if i.val<(a x).val then (1:ℝ) else 0)) =
      1-∑ x ∈ initial a i, w x := by
    have hsplit : (∑ x, w x*(if i.val<(a x).val then (1:ℝ) else 0)) +
        (∑ x ∈ initial a i, w x) = 1 := by
      rw [initial, Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      calc
        _ = ∑ x, w x := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro x _
          by_cases h : i.val<(a x).val
          · simp [h, Nat.not_le.mpr h]
          · simp [h, Nat.le_of_not_gt h]
        _ = 1 := hw
    linarith
  have he : meanColor w a = 1+∑ i : Fin s, (1-∑ x ∈ initial a i, w x) := by
    unfold meanColor
    simp_rw [color_layers, mul_add, mul_one, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hw, Finset.sum_comm]
    simp_rw [htail]
  rw [he]
  have ht : (∑ i : Fin s, (1-∑ x ∈ initial a i, w x)) ≤ ∑ i : Fin s, deficit i :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => by linarith [hcap i])
  have hd : (∑ i : Fin s, deficit i) ≤ 1 := by
    have h := geom_positive_sum_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/2) (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ)<1) s
    simp only [deficit, ← one_div_pow]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => (1/2:ℝ)^(i+1)) s]
    norm_num at h ⊢
    exact h
  linarith

/-- The mean-color conclusion of the multiscale selector. -/
theorem mean_selector {F : Finset (Finset X)} {w : Finset X → X → ℝ}
    (hw0 : ∀ H ∈ F, ∀ x, 0 ≤ w H x) (hw1 : ∀ H ∈ F, ∑ x, w H x = 1)
    (hsupp : ∀ H ∈ F, ∀ x ∉ H, w H x = 0)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hF : ¬ Small p F)
    (hs : p*(∑ j : Fin s, (256:ℝ)^(j.val+1)) ≤ 1/2) :
    (9:ℝ)/10 ≤ ∑ a : Coloring X s,
      if ∃ H ∈ F, meanColor (w H) a ≤ 2 then productMass (colorProb p s) a else 0 := by
  refine (multiscale_selector hw0 hw1 hsupp hp hF hs).trans ?_
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro a _
  by_cases ha : ∃ H ∈ F, ∀ i : Fin s, 1-deficit i ≤ ∑ x ∈ initial a i, w H x
  · obtain ⟨H,hH,hcap⟩ := ha
    have hmean : ∃ H ∈ F, meanColor (w H) a ≤ 2 := ⟨H,hH,meanColor_le_two _ _ (hw1 H hH) hcap⟩
    simp [hmean]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | exact productMass_nonneg (fun i => (colorProb_pos hp hs i).le) a
  · simp only [if_neg ha]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | exact productMass_nonneg (fun i => (colorProb_pos hp hs i).le) a

end
end TalagrandIntegral

import TalagrandIntegral.Weights

set_option autoImplicit false

open Finset Classical
namespace TalagrandIntegral
noncomputable section
variable {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] {s : ℕ}

def avgColor (a : Coloring X s) (S : Finset X) : ℝ :=
  (∑ x ∈ S, ((a x).val+1:ℝ)) / S.card

def coverPolynomial (g : Finset X → ℝ) (y : X → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ S ∈ nonemptySubsets (univ : Finset X), g S * ∏ x ∈ S, y x

theorem coverPolynomial_nonneg {g : Finset X → ℝ} {y : X → ℝ}
    (hg : ∀ S, 0 ≤ g S) (hy : ∀ x, 0 ≤ y x) : 0 ≤ coverPolynomial g y :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun S _ => mul_nonneg (hg S) (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun x _ => hy x)))

theorem prod_colorY_ge_one (a : Coloring X s) {S : Finset X} (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (havg : avgColor a S ≤ 4) : 1 ≤ ∏ x ∈ S, colorY (a x) := by
  have hc : (0:ℝ) < S.card := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hS
  have hsum : (∑ x ∈ S, ((a x).val+1:ℝ)) ≤ 4*S.card := (div_le_iff₀ hc).mp havg
  have hn : (∑ x ∈ S, ((a x).val+1)) ≤ 4*S.card := by exact_mod_cast hsum
  have he : (∏ x ∈ S, colorY (a x)) =
      (512:ℝ)^(4*S.card) / (512:ℝ)^(∑ x ∈ S, ((a x).val+1)) := by
    simp only [colorY, Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_const, ← pow_mul,
      Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
  rw [he]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
  simpa using (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)≤512) hn)

theorem good_mass_half {I : Type} [DecidableEq I] (E : Finset I) (g f : I → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ i ∈ E, 0 ≤ g i) (hf : ∀ i ∈ E, 0 ≤ f i)
    (hm : (∑ i ∈ E, g i*f i) ≤ 2*∑ i ∈ E, g i) :
    (∑ i ∈ E, g i)/2 ≤ ∑ i ∈ E, if f i≤4 then g i else 0 := by
  have hpoint (i) (hi : i∈E) : 4*g i ≤ g i*f i + 4*(if f i≤4 then g i else 0) := by
    by_cases h : f i≤4
    · simp only [if_pos h]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (hg i hi) (hf i hi)]
    · simp only [if_neg h, mul_zero, add_zero]
      simpa only [mul_comm (g i) 4] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_not_ge h) (hg i hi)
  have h := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => hpoint i hi)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum] at h
  linarith

theorem coverPolynomial_large {r : ℝ} (hr : 0≤r) {F : Finset (Finset X)} {g : Finset X → ℝ}
    (hg : FractionalCover r F g) (a : Coloring X s) {H : Finset X} (hH : H∈F)
    (hmean : meanColor (subsetWeights g H) a ≤ 2) :
    1/4 ≤ coverPolynomial g (fun x => colorY (a x)) := by
  have hm : 1/2 ≤ subsetMass g H := fractional_mass hr hg hH
  have hm0 : 0 < subsetMass g H := by linarith
  have hstat : (∑ S ∈ nonemptySubsets H, g S*avgColor a S) ≤ 2*subsetMass g H := by
    have he := subsetWeights_statistic g H (fun x => ((a x).val+1:ℝ)) (ne_of_gt hm0)
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmean hm0.le
    change meanColor (subsetWeights g H) a * subsetMass g H = _ at he
    rw [he] at hmul
    simpa only [avgColor, mul_div_assoc] using hmul
  have hgood := good_mass_half (nonemptySubsets H) g (avgColor a)
    (fun S _ => (hg.1 S).1) (fun S _ => div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x _ => by positivity)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) hstat
  have hsub : nonemptySubsets H ⊆ nonemptySubsets (univ : Finset X) := by
    intro S hS
    exact mem_nonemptySubsets.mpr ⟨(mem_nonemptySubsets.mp hS).1, Finset.subset_univ _⟩
  have hpoly : (∑ S ∈ nonemptySubsets H, if avgColor a S≤4 then g S else 0) ≤
      coverPolynomial g (fun x => colorY (a x)) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ S ∈ nonemptySubsets H, g S*∏x∈S,colorY (a x) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro S hS
        by_cases h : avgColor a S≤4
        · simp only [if_pos h]
          exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (hg.1 S).1 (prod_colorY_ge_one a (mem_nonemptySubsets.mp hS).1 h)
        · simp only [if_neg h]
          exact mul_nonneg (hg.1 S).1 (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun x _ => (colorY_pos _).le))
      _ ≤ coverPolynomial g (fun x => colorY (a x)) := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub
          (fun S _ _ => mul_nonneg (hg.1 S).1 (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun x _ => (colorY_pos _).le)))
  change subsetMass g H / 2 ≤ _ at hgood
  linarith

end
end TalagrandIntegral

import TalagrandIntegral.Counting

set_option autoImplicit false

open Finset Classical
namespace TalagrandIntegral
noncomputable section
variable {s : ℕ}

def colorProb (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (i : Fin (s+1)) : ℝ :=
  if i.val < s then (256:ℝ)^(i.val+1)*p else 1-p*∑ j : Fin s, (256:ℝ)^(j.val+1)

theorem colorProb_early (p : ℝ) (i : Fin s) :
    colorProb p s i.castSucc = (256:ℝ)^(i.val+1)*p := by simp [colorProb, i.isLt]
theorem colorProb_last (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) :
    colorProb p s (Fin.last s) = 1-p*∑ j : Fin s, (256:ℝ)^(j.val+1) := by
  simp [colorProb]

theorem colorProb_pos {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hs : p*(∑ j : Fin s, (256:ℝ)^(j.val+1)) ≤ 1/2) (i : Fin (s+1)) :
    0 < colorProb p s i := by
  unfold colorProb
  split_ifs
  · positivity
  · linarith

theorem colorProb_sum (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) : (∑ i, colorProb p s i) = 1 := by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  simp_rw [colorProb_early, colorProb_last, ← Finset.sum_mul]
  ring

theorem geom_positive_sum_le {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hb1 : b < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range n, b^(j+1)) ≤ b/(1-b) := by
  have hd : 0 < 1-b := by linarith
  have he : (b/(1-b))*(1-b) = b := div_mul_cancel₀ b (ne_of_gt hd)
  induction n with
  | zero => simp; exact div_nonneg hb hd.le
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    have hs : (∑ j ∈ range n, b^(j+1+1)) = b*(∑ j ∈ range n, b^(j+1)) := by
      simp [pow_succ, Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm]
    rw [hs]
    simp only [zero_add, pow_one]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hb]

theorem colorProb_moveRate {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hs : p*(∑ j : Fin s, (256:ℝ)^(j.val+1)) ≤ 1/2) :
    moveRate p (colorProb p s) ≤ 1/63 := by
  let π := colorProb p s
  have hπ := colorProb_pos hp hs
  have hsum := colorProb_sum p s
  have hrepr : moveRate p π = ∑ i : Fin (s+1),
      ((2:ℝ)^(i.val+1)*p/π i) * ∑ h : Fin (s+1), if i < h then π h else 0 := by
    unfold moveRate
    have he : (∑ m : MoveType s, (2:ℝ)^(m.val.1.val+1)*moveWeight p π m) =
        ∑ m : Fin (s+1) × Fin (s+1), if m.1 < m.2 then
          (2:ℝ)^(m.1.val+1)*p*π m.2/π m.1 else 0 := by
      have hsub : (∑ m : Fin (s+1) × Fin (s+1), if m.1 < m.2 then
          (2:ℝ)^(m.1.val+1)*p*π m.2/π m.1 else 0) =
          ∑ m : MoveType s, (2:ℝ)^(m.val.1.val+1)*p*π m.val.2/π m.val.1 := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
        exact Finset.sum_subtype _ (by simp) _
      rw [hsub]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro m _; simp [moveWeight]; ring
    rw [he, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro h _
    split_ifs <;> ring
  rw [hrepr, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  have hlast : (∑ h : Fin (s+1), if Fin.last s < h then π h else 0) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro h _
    rw [if_neg (not_lt_of_ge (Fin.le_last h))]
  rw [hlast, mul_zero, add_zero]
  have htail (i : Fin (s+1)) : (∑ h : Fin (s+1), if i < h then π h else 0) ≤ 1 := by
    have h := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := (univ : Finset (Fin (s+1))))
      (fun h _ => show (if i < h then π h else 0) ≤ π h from by split_ifs <;> first | rfl | exact (hπ h).le)
    exact h.trans_eq hsum
  have he (i : Fin s) : (2:ℝ)^(i.castSucc.val+1)*p/π i.castSucc = (1/128:ℝ)^(i.val+1) := by
    dsimp [π]
    rw [colorProb_early]
    have hh : (2:ℝ)^(i.val+1)*p / ((256:ℝ)^(i.val+1)*p) =
        (2:ℝ)^(i.val+1)/(256:ℝ)^(i.val+1) := by field_simp
    rw [hh, ← div_pow]
    norm_num
  simp_rw [he]
  have h := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := (univ : Finset (Fin s)))
    (fun i _ => mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity : 0 ≤ (1/128:ℝ)^(i.val+1)) (htail i.castSucc))
  have hg := geom_positive_sum_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/128) (by norm_num : (1/128:ℝ) < 1) s
  have hgf : (∑ i : Fin s, (1/128:ℝ)^(i.val+1)) ≤ 1/127 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => (1/128:ℝ)^(j+1)) s]
    norm_num at hg ⊢
    exact hg
  exact h.trans (hgf.trans (by norm_num))

end
end TalagrandIntegral

import TalagrandIntegral.Colorings

set_option autoImplicit false

open Finset Classical
namespace TalagrandIntegral
noncomputable section
variable {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] {s t : ℕ}

abbrev MoveType (s : ℕ) := {ij : Fin (s+1) × Fin (s+1) // ij.1 < ij.2}
def moveCut (m : MoveType s) : Fin s :=
  ⟨m.val.1.val, by have h := m.property; have h' := m.val.2.isLt; omega⟩

def moveWord {a z : Coloring X s} (e : Fin t ≃ ↥(changed a z)) : Fin t → MoveType s :=
  fun j => ⟨(z (e j), a (e j)), (mem_filter.mp (e j).property).2⟩

def wordCrossings (u : Fin t → MoveType s) (i : Fin s) : Finset (Fin t) :=
  univ.filter (fun j => (u j).val.1.val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < (u j).val.2.val)

theorem crossings_card_word {a z : Coloring X s} (e : Fin t ≃ ↥(changed a z)) (i : Fin s) :
    (crossings a z i).card = (wordCrossings (moveWord e) i).card := by
  symm
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun j _ => (e j).val)
  · intro j hj
    simpa [wordCrossings, moveWord, crossings] using hj
  · intro j hj k hk he
    exact e.injective (Subtype.ext he)
  · intro x hx
    have hc : x ∈ changed a z := by
      simp only [crossings, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hx
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ x, (show (z x).val < (a x).val from lt_of_le_of_lt hx.1 hx.2)⟩
    refine ⟨e.symm ⟨x, hc⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [wordCrossings, moveWord, crossings] using hx
    · simp

theorem word_reconstructs {a b z : Coloring X s} (ha : z ≤ a) (hb : z ≤ b)
    (e : Fin t ≃ ↥(changed a z)) (f : Fin t ≃ ↥(changed b z))
    (hword : moveWord e = moveWord f)
    (hpos : ∀ j, (e j).val = (f j).val) : a = b := by
  funext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ changed a z
  · let j := e.symm ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hex : (e j).val = x := by simp [j]
    have hfx : (f j).val = x := (hpos j).symm.trans hex
    have h := congrArg (fun u => (u j).val.2) hword
    simpa [moveWord, hex, hfx] using h
  · have hbx : x ∉ changed b z := by
      intro hbx
      let j := f.symm ⟨x, hbx⟩
      have he : (e j).val = x := (hpos j).trans (by simp [j])
      exact hx (he ▸ (e j).property)
    have ha' : ¬ z x < a x := by simpa [changed] using hx
